title: Preparation geometry and slow-sector routing in driven Kerr resonators: an operational spectral theory of Liouvillians
summary: Liouvillian eigenvalues determine decay rates and oscillation frequencies, but not how the corresponding modes are excited, propagated, and detected in a chosen protocol. We develop an operational spectral theory based on matched left and right eigenoperators. Left eigenoperators determine excitation by an input or source; right eigenoperators determine the propagated density deformation and readout overlap; their product is a gauge-invariant modal weight.
